name: Polperro
address: 150 Red Hill Road, Red Hill VIC 3937
signature: Small-production cool-climate pinot and chardonnay poured in one of the prettiest tasting rooms on the ridge.
editorNote:
Polperro feels smaller and more intimate than some of the region's trophy estates, which is exactly its appeal. The cellar door is tucked into the vines with a line of sight over the ridge, the pours are thoughtful, and the whole place carries the tone of a producer that cares more about the wine than the performance around it.

The cellar door pours Polperro and Even Keel wines. Pair a tasting with lunch and you have one of the gentlest half-days in Red Hill South.

For a midweek visit, choose Wednesday, Thursday or Friday. The restaurant and cellar door are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

visiting.tastingNote: Walk-in only, maximum 6 guests, no bookings required for cellar door. Tasting includes Polperro and Even Keel wines. Restaurant requires separate booking. The restaurant and cellar door are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

restaurant.name: Polperro Restaurant
restaurant.description: 1 Hat in the Age Good Food Guide 2024 and 2025. Modern Australian cuisine connected to the estate's organic ethos. Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays; check current service times before booking.

accommodation.name: Polperro Vineyard Villas
accommodation.description: Four vineyard villas, each sleeping two with a king-size bed, indoor spa, open fireplace and vineyard views. Cooking facilities are a convection oven and microwave; there are no hotplates or outdoor baths. Book at https://www.polperrowines.com.au/escape/.

editorVerdict: Polperro earns its reputation quietly. Sam Coverdale's winemaking is unhurried and honest, and the winery identifies Talland Hill as its vineyard certified organic and biodynamic in 2019. Its single-vineyard wines let the different sites speak. The Red Hill property brings a restaurant with a hat and accommodation in the vines - one of the Peninsula's most complete stay-and-taste propositions.
whyWeGo: Polperro's scale, small, owner-operated, unhurried, is the thing itself, not just a selling point; the room rewards the kind of afternoon you don't try to plan.
ifOnlyOneThing: Visit Wednesday to Sunday, taste Polperro and Even Keel wines, and stay for lunch rather than rushing on to the next stop.

faq.q: Does Polperro take walk-ins or do you need to book?
faq.a: The cellar door is walk-in only (maximum 6 guests), no bookings required. Open Wednesday to Sunday, 11am–5pm. The restaurant requires a separate booking. The restaurant and cellar door are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.
Yes. Polperro Restaurant holds 1 Hat in The Age Good Food Guide 2024 and 2025. Modern Australian cuisine. The restaurant and cellar door are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.
No. Free-range chickens and other farm animals are on the property.
